sections.heading: Rewritten post
sections.body:
Code review isn't about catching bugs. It's about building shared understanding.

At Acme Corp, our best reviews rarely found bugs -- they closed knowledge gaps. A junior engineer's PR once taught three senior engineers something new about our own system.

That's the real payoff.

bullets.text: Cut the throat-clearing opening sentence -- started directly on the claim instead.
Tightened the middle paragraph from three sentences to two.
The closing line would land harder with a specific number (e.g. how many PRs this happened on) -- flagging since that detail isn't in the original.
